references.text: Psalm 103:3, which speaks of forgiveness of all your sins, reflects the idea of the remission of sins that Jesus gives to the paralytic.
Isaiah 33:24, where no inhabitant will say, "I am sick"; the people who live there will have their sins forgiven, which corresponds with Jesus' forgiveness of sins and healing.
Matthew 9:6 emphasizes Jesus' authority to forgive sins on earth, which is directly related to the event in verse 2.
Mark 2:5, where Jesus also forgives sins, refers to a similar incident that illustrates Jesus' power to forgive sins.
Luke 5:20, which also tells of forgiveness of sins for a paralyzed man, points to Jesus' ability and authority to forgive sins.
